description: This file implements the DobbyInterface class, which manages container lifecycle operations such as start, stop, pause, resume, and state change notifications for containers managed via Dobby. It includes methods for container management, event handling, and integration with external proxies and IPC services.

classes.name: DobbyInterface
classes.description: A class that manages container lifecycle operations and event notifications for containers managed via Dobby.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DobbyInterface with an event handler, sets up IPC service, and registers event listeners.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters event listeners, and resets the event handler.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently running containers.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specified container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a container from an OCI bundle.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby-specific specification.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container.

methods.name: pauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a running container.

methods.name: resumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: hibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernates a container.

methods.name: wakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: annotate
methods.description: Adds an annotation to a container.

methods.name: removeAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation from a container.

methods.name: mount
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem in a container.

methods.name: unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a filesystem from a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Event handler for container start events.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Event handler for container stop events.

methods.name: onContainerStateChanged
methods.description: Event handler for container state change events.

methods.name: onVerityFailed
methods.description: Handles verity check failure for a container.

methods.name: GetContainerDescriptorFromId
methods.description: Converts container ID to internal Dobby descriptor.

methods.name: GetContainerIdFromDescriptor
methods.description: Converts internal Dobby descriptor to container ID.

methods.name: stateListener
methods.description: Callback for container state change events.

methods.name: omiErrorListener
methods.description: Callback for OMI error events.

methods.name: is_encrypted
methods.description: Checks if the container bundle is encrypted.
